facts.fact: 看房信息来自 Sean：Gunderson 夫妇的出租屋，离他父母小屋一英里。
facts.anchor: Thanks to Sean, I was able to find a time to look at the Gundersons’ house, which is just a mile away from his parents’ cabin.

facts.fact: 她迫切到准备付六个月预付金——「我需要住在这里，需要这份安宁」。
facts.anchor: I need to live out here. I need the peace and quiet.

facts.fact: 纽约往事：她坚持在书店工作（Graham 说她不必工作）——那份工作是她逃离窒息婚姻的出口。
facts.anchor: Graham insisted that I didn’t need to work, but not even a bull dozer could have stopped me from getting that job.

facts.fact: 她盘算用离婚分得的钱在 Lakewood 开自己的书店。
facts.anchor: With the money from the divorce, maybe I could open my own bookstore.

facts.fact: 父亲听到 Sean Kingsley 的名字很吃惊（她此前只说见过老朋友）。
facts.anchor: “Sean Kingsley? Gosh, I didn’t know you still spoke with him,”

facts.fact: 十二个月租约让她觉得像一辈子。
facts.anchor: It’s a twelve month lease which feels so long.

facts.fact: Mrs. Gunderson 神助攻：Sean 谈起她的样子就是恋爱中的人。
facts.anchor: I’ve seen many people in love and many people who think they’re in love—just the way Sean was speaking about you.

facts.fact: 章末：她感觉已经住进了这个房子——终于感觉在 move on。
facts.anchor: It feels like I already have the place. Finally, it feels like moving on.
